title: Liability Determination Table for Denied Lines (Insulin Pump Program)
content:
On an Insulin Pump Program, the charge on a line denied CO-151 follows the tier and the line's liability records:

| Tier | Liability record | Effect on the standard write-off |
|---|---|---|
| Insulin Pump Medicare Advantage Program | the plan issued an organization determination denial for the line's item (recorded as a prior authorization denial for that item) | replaced with a charge of every denied unit at the cash price per unit |
| any other tier | the newest liability notice signed against the line's grant was signed on or before the line's ship date | replaced with a charge of the lesser of the denied units and that notice's units at the cash price per unit |
| any tier | neither of the above | the standard write-off stands |

A notice signed after the ship date covers only later lines of the grant.

## Points of judgement

- On the Medicare Advantage tier a signed notice does not make units chargeable; only the plan's organization determination denial for the item does.
- On every other tier the newest notice signed against the grant the denied line drew on is read, and it must have been signed no later than the line's ship date.

| Hypothetical case (15 denied A4225 units at $6.85) | Charge under this table |
|---|---|
| Commercial PPO tier; newest notice against the line's grant, 20 units, signed on the ship date | 15 units, $102.75 |
| Commercial PPO tier; newest notice, 8 units, signed before the ship date | 8 units, $54.80 |
| Commercial PPO tier; an older notice before the ship date and a newer one the day after | the standard write-off stands |
| Medicare Advantage tier; organization determination denial for the item | 15 units, $102.75 |
